name: sbc-code
description: Local-first autonomous AI coding agent for VS Code: Ollama and Colibri models, verified on-disk edits, checkpoints, animated sidebar and verified automatic updates.

commands.title: SBC Code: Restore Last AI Edit
SBC Code: Fix Current File Diagnostics

sbcCode.baseUrl.description: Base URL for Colibri/OpenAI-compatible provider. Ollama has its own sbcCode.ollamaBaseUrl.

sbcCode.model.description: Optional fixed model ID for Colibri/OpenAI-compatible providers. Leave empty to use the sidebar picker.

sbcCode.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens per request.

sbcCode.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat and code edits.

sbcCode.maxContextChars.description: Maximum selected-code characters attached to a request; longer selections are rejected.

sbcCode.allowInsecureRemote.description: Allow unencrypted HTTP connections to non-local servers. Not recommended when sending source code.

sbcCode.inlineSuggestions.description: Enable optional AI inline ghost-text suggestions. Disabled by default because Colibri models on CPU may be slow.

sbcCode.updateNotifications.deprecationMessage: Use sbcCode.autoUpdate instead. Setting this to false still disables update checks when sbcCode.autoUpdate is not set.

enumDescriptions: Download, verify (SHA-256 and size) and install new stable releases automatically, then offer to reload
Only notify when a new stable release is available
sbcCode.autoUpdate.description: How SBC Code keeps itself up to date from official GitHub Releases. Checks run at startup (at most hourly across windows), every six hours and when the window regains focus. No source code is sent.

sbcCode.provider.description: Default AI inference provider. The sidebar selector persists its choice in VS Code extension storage without writing User Settings; manual Settings changes are supported.

sbcCode.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama server origin. Accepts http://127.0.0.1:11434 or an endpoint ending in /v1. Non-local servers require HTTPS unless explicitly allowed.

sbcCode.ollamaModel.description: Optional fixed Ollama model name, e.g. qwen3-coder:latest. Leave empty to use the sidebar's model selection.

enumDescriptions: Automatically create, edit and save files inside the trusted workspace
Show diffs and ask approval before each edit
sbcCode.agentEditMode.description: File edit policy for SBC Code Agent and Edit Selection. Automatic edits are restricted to a trusted local workspace. Terminal commands still require separate approval.

sbcCode.agentMaxSteps.description: Maximum model round-trips per Agent request. Each step may call several tools (up to three tool calls per step in total). Lower values respond faster on CPU-only machines.

sbcCode.showSplash.description: Show the animated SBC Code splash screen while the sidebar connects to the model server. It closes as soon as the server responds.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/*.test.js && node --check media/webview.js
